edges.reason: payday resolves the employee from employeeIds[msg.sender].
vote uses msg.sender to look up voter stake.
Vault.transfer requires msg.sender to hold TRANSFER_ROLE.
transfer moves tokens owned by msg.sender.
onRegisterAsHook stores msg.sender as the token manager.
determineAllocation is keyed by msg.sender via employeeMatches.
getTimestamp() returns block.timestamp, a miner-influenceable value.
Vote open window depends on block.timestamp.
Survey open window depends on block.timestamp.
revokeVesting computes non-vested tokens from current time.
nextPaymentTime is compared against the current timestamp.
Owed salary depends on elapsed time.
proxyPayment is restricted to the token address.
forward blacklists the managed token address.
hooksLength bounds the approve hook loop.
hooksLength bounds the transfer hook loop.

normalization_plan.reason: Initialization parameter is only meaningful through the initialize core function.
Mint receiver parameter belongs to the mint core function.
Mint amount parameter belongs to the mint core function.
Vote id parameter belongs to the vote core function.
Payment type parameter belongs to the payday core function.
Requested amount parameter belongs to the payday core function.
Target parameter flows directly into the Agent.execute unsafe call.
ETH value parameter flows directly into the Agent.execute call.
Calldata parameter flows directly into the Agent.execute call.
Recipient parameter is only relevant inside Vault.transfer.
Local vesting id is produced and returned only by assignVested.
Local paid counter is only meaningful inside _executePayment.
Local snapshot block is only used inside _newVote.
